_measurements: chestCm and waistCm are REAL Druids figures. heightCm and weightKg are OUR estimates - Druids publishes no height or weight mapping - so they are weighted far lower and always produce a lower confidence. Never present them as the brand's guidance.

tops.label: Polos, midlayers, hoodies, jackets and gilets
tops._note: Druids uses one chest chart across all of these.
tops.measure: Measure at the fullest part of the chest, under the armpits and over the shoulder blades, keeping the tape firm and level.

shorts.label: Shorts
shorts._note: Druids publishes one waist figure per size, not a range. The bands below sit halfway to the neighbouring size.
shorts.measure: Measure around the natural waistline, where you normally wear the waistband.

trousers.label: Trousers and joggers
trousers._note: Druids sizes these waist/length, e.g. 32/32. We recommend the waist; leg length is a second question the customer answers themselves.
trousers.measure: Measure around the natural waistline. Inside leg is measured from the crotch to the floor.
